name: RTX Gorilla Tag‎‎
summary:
Welcome to RTX Gorilla Tag – the Ultimate Realism Overhaul of the Classic Experience!

Step into the wildest game of tag you’ve ever seen, now reimagined with ultra-realistic graphics, cinematic lighting, and lifelike environments. RTX Gorilla Tag isn’t just a visual upgrade—it’s a full-blown immersive evolution of the beloved Gorilla Tag gameplay, brought to life with cutting-edge ray tracing and next-gen rendering technology.
